                  Post-Login Investigation
                  Correlate startup persistence with observed process and window activity.

                  STEP 1 — PREPARE

                  C.U.R.E. will observe startup activity for a limited period. Observation installs nothing and modifies nothing — no Startup, registry, service, or task changes. For true post-login capture, start the observation within a minute of logging in; a reboot flow is intentionally not offered.

                  STEP 2–3 — OBSERVE & CORRELATE (AUTOMATIC)

                  —

                  Correlation does not by itself establish malicious intent. Levels: DIRECT (matched path + process) · STRONG (matched command/path + timing) · PARTIAL (matched name only) · WEAK (temporal/structural proximity only) · NONE (no observed relationship).
